final_message:
Built the high-sensitivity strategy and saved it as a single line in [final_strategy.txt](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-dc89f4701b07ff28/lean-optimal-codex-noseed-20260927T093504Z/final_strategy.txt). The construction notes, MeSH checks, and PubMed block counts are in [search_report.md](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-dc89f4701b07ff28/lean-optimal-codex-noseed-20260927T093504Z/work/search_report.md).

The query requires TNBC and immune checkpoint inhibition. Early-stage disease and chemotherapy are left for screening: adding either as a required block reduced retrieval in the cutoff-capped tests. The expanded query returned 1,220 records; adding early-stage terms returned 404, and adding chemotherapy terms returned 629.

**Cutoff caveat:** E-utilities returned sample records labeled 2025 despite the Jan 31 date limits, without enough date detail to verify they fell before the cutoff. I excluded those samples from the final evidence; the saved query retains both publication-date and entry-date limits through 2025-01-31. The strategy is a draft and should receive PRESS review before final use.
